The Metal Forming segment manufactures refined special sections, tubes, and precision strip steel products; pre-finished system components made from pressed, punched, and roll-profiled parts; and storage system solutions for manufacturers in the automotive production and supply industries, as well as various companies in the commercial vehicle, construction, storage, energy, and agricultural machinery industries. It serves automotive, energy, railway systems, construction, mechanical engineering, white goods/consumer goods, aerospace, and other industries. Voestalpine AG is headquartered in Linz, Austria.
